# netactuate_tag_logs (Data Source)

Reads Tag Logs visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_tag_logs" "example" {
  tag_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID whose logs will be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `logs` (List of Object) Log entries for the tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `log_id` (Number)
- `message` (String)
- `raw_json` (String)
- `tag_id` (Number)
